note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) campground on Divide Lake, 4.25 miles east of Isabella on Forest Road 172, which follows the Laurentian Divide here. Gravel pull-in sites in spruce and birch; site 1 looks out on the lake through the trees. Walk-down canoe launch to the stocked trout lake and the 2-mile Divide Lake Trail with overlooks; the single backcountry site on the lake is reached by canoe. --Claude
